name: libretranslate
description: Self-hosted machine translation using LibreTranslate/Argos. Translate between 50+ languages. Auto-downloads models on first use. Supports detecting language of any text. Available language codes: ar (Arabic), az (Azerbaijani), bg (Bulgarian), bn (Bengali), ca (Catalan), cs (Czech), da (Danish), de (German), el (Greek), en (English), eo (Esperanto), es (Spanish), et (Estonian), eu (Basque), fa (Persian), fi (Finnish), fr (French), ga (Irish), gl (Galician), he (Hebrew), hi (Hindi), hu (Hungarian), id (Indonesian), it (Italian), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean), ky (Kyrgyz), lt (Lithuanian), lv (Latvian), ms (Malay), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nl (Dutch), pb (Pushto), pl (Polish), pt (Portuguese), ro (Romanian), ru (Russian), sk (Slovak), sl (Slovenian), sq (Albanian), sv (Swedish), sw (Swahili), th (Thai), tl (Tagalog), tr (Turkish), uk (Ukrainian), ur (Urdu), vi (Vietnamese), zh (Chinese Simplified), zt (Chinese Traditional).
target_hint: language_code (e.g. bn, fr, ja) for translate; leave empty for detect; 'languages' or 'installed' for list

translate: text | source_lang (source optional, defaults to en)

function.name: libretranslate
function.description: Self-hosted machine translation using LibreTranslate/Argos. Translate between 50+ languages. Supports detecting language of any text.

action.description: Action verb. One of: translate, detect, list

target.description: Language code for translate; empty for detect; 'languages' or 'installed' for list

payload.description: Text to translate or detect language of
